theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Energy is eligible, trending (Hurst trend), with moderate durability (0.69) and breadth (0.62), and notably not crowded (crowded=false). This offers uptrend exposure without the reflexivity risk of crowded themes, aligned with the drawdown-avoidance edge of the absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only moderate and could narrow; a sharp drop in oil prices or a macro growth scare could reverse the trend quickly.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 20-day simple moving average on a weekly basis AND breadth drops below 0.4.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Despite being the ranked leader, the theme is showing clear momentum deterioration: r10 negative (-0.189), val_state='fading', breadth zero, and a low durability bar (0.5). The absolute-trend gate is still passed (eligible) but fragile; avoiding it aligns with the drawdown-control edge of the gate.

falsifier.text: r10 turns positive AND breadth expands above 0.3, OR the durability bar rises above 0.65.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
